title: Electronic Service Provider's Obligation to Designate a Nodal Officer

content.scenario: An e-commerce platform operates in India and provides services to consumers. The platform must designate a nodal officer to accept and process notices from consumers.
content.outcome: The electronic service provider shall designate a nodal officer to accept and process notices, as required by Section 65(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, for the purpose of accepting and processing notices.

user_queries: What is the role of a nodal officer in an e-commerce platform?
Is an e-commerce platform required to designate a nodal officer in India?
How can a consumer serve a notice on an electronic service provider?
